phrases: pain in left arm and chest
pressure in chest and jaw pain
chest pain spreading to my arm
chest pain and left arm pain
chest pain with breathlessness and sweating
flags.message: Chest pain that spreads to the arm, jaw or back, especially with sweating or breathlessness, can be a heart attack.

phrases: weakness on one side of the body
numbness on one side of the body
side of body has gone numb
arm and leg numb on one side
flags.message: Sudden weakness on one side, drooping face, slurred speech or a sudden worst-ever headache can be a stroke. Time matters enormously here.
Severe difficulty breathing or blue lips needs emergency oxygen and assessment.
Loss of consciousness, fainting or a seizure needs to be assessed in person straight away.
Bringing up blood or bleeding that will not stop needs emergency care.

phrases: light hurts eyes with stiff neck
flags.message: Fever with a stiff neck, a rash that does not fade under pressure, or severe light sensitivity can indicate meningitis.

phrases: cannot stand up from stomach pain
flags.message: Sudden severe abdominal pain with a rigid, board-like belly can be a surgical emergency.
You deserve support from a real person right now, not a symptom checker.
